brand.subtitle.zh: 手 帐 文 具 店

brand.note.en: A little more you, every day.

brand.motto.zh: 记录生活的美好，也收藏一点点变好的自己。

preview.label.zh: HTML 交互预览 · 非 SwiftUI 运行画面
preview.label.en: Interactive HTML preview · not running SwiftUI

preview.footer.zh: 数据保存在当前浏览器 · 示例内容可编辑
preview.footer.en: Saved in this browser · sample entries are editable

home.subtitle.zh: 记录生活，也记录一点点变好的自己。
home.subtitle.en: Collect a moment. Grow a little, gently.

home.blankBody.zh:
一张照片，一句心情。
平凡的日子也值得被收藏。
home.blankBody.en:
A photo, a feeling.
Even ordinary days deserve a page.

home.studio.zh: 把今天，拼贴成喜欢的样子 ↗
home.studio.en: Make today a page you love ↗

calendar.subtitle.zh: 每个日子，都值得被记住。
calendar.subtitle.en: Every day has a little story.

calendar.empty.zh: 这一天的故事，还在等你写下。
calendar.empty.en: This day is waiting for its little story.

calendar.linked.zh: 已完成 {count} 项习惯，与当天手帐共用日期。
calendar.linked.en: {count} habits completed, linked to this journal date.

growth.subtitle.zh: 一点一点，成为更喜欢的自己。
growth.subtitle.en: Little by little, a little more you.

growth.headline.en: No rush. Just a little growth. 🌱

growth.description.zh: 每一次小小的坚持，都在悄悄发光。
growth.description.en: Every little effort is quietly shining.

growth.weekCount.zh: 每周 {target} 次 · 已完成 {count} 次

growth.flower.en: Your first little flower has bloomed

growth.seed.zh: 每次坚持，都是一颗种子
growth.seed.en: Every effort plants a little seed

growth.remaining.zh: 再记录 {count} 次，点亮第一朵花
growth.remaining.en: {count} more steps to your first flower

growth.linked.zh: 打卡会自动出现在对应日期的成长日历里。
growth.linked.en: Check-ins appear on the same date in your growth calendar.

books.subtitle.zh: 给每一种热爱，一本小小的收藏。
books.subtitle.en: A home for every little love.

books.empty.zh: 手帐本的第一页，等你来写。
books.empty.en: The first page is waiting for you.

books.dialogDescription.zh: 任何主题，都值得拥有专属手帐。
books.dialogDescription.en: Any theme can have a book of its own.

books.namePlaceholder.zh: 例如：我的植物养护手帐

books.privateNotice.zh: 本阶段仅本机私人记录。公开发布与协作将在后续阶段启用。
books.privateNotice.en: This phase is private and local. Publishing and collaboration come later.

studio.subtitle.zh: 让今天，成为一张喜欢的手帐。
studio.subtitle.en: Make today a page you love.

studio.draftHint.zh: 改动将自动保存为草稿
studio.draftHint.en: Changes save automatically as a draft

studio.quickHelp.zh: 选一张照片，写一句心情，即可自动排版。
studio.quickHelp.en: Pick a photo, add a note. Your page comes together.

studio.help.zh: 照片、视频和声音只保存在这台设备上。导出的图片里，视频和声音不能播放；需要的话请导出视频。
studio.help.en: Photos, videos and sounds stay on this device. An exported picture can't play video or sound — export a video for that.

layer.selected.zh: 已选择元素 · 拖动或调整参数
layer.selected.en: Element selected · drag or adjust below

media.empty.zh: 让声音和影像，也住进手帐里。
media.empty.en: A home for voices and moving moments, too.

media.missing.zh: 媒体文件暂不可用，请恢复备份或重新上传。
media.missing.en: Media is unavailable. Restore a backup or upload it again.

media.recordUnsupported.zh: 此浏览器不支持录音，仍可上传音频。
media.recordUnsupported.en: Recording is not supported here. You can still upload audio.

media.denied.zh: 未获得麦克风权限，请在浏览器设置中允许，或上传音频文件。
media.denied.en: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in browser settings or upload an audio file.

media.limit.zh: 视频限 50 MB，音频限 20 MB；文件需为浏览器支持的格式。
media.limit.en: Videos: up to 50 MB. Audio: up to 20 MB. Use a browser-supported format.

media.busy.zh: 媒体正在保存或录音，请完成后再切换页面。
media.busy.en: Finish saving media or stop recording before leaving.

media.imageLimit.zh: 请选择小于 20 MB 的图片。
media.imageLimit.en: Choose an image smaller than 20 MB.

media.failed.zh: 媒体未保存，请检查格式、存储空间后重试。
media.failed.en: Media was not saved. Check its format and available storage.

media.savedPhoto.zh: 照片已加入，也已保存到草稿。
media.savedPhoto.en: Photo added and saved to your draft.

media.loaded.zh: 旧照片已迁移到媒体库，原有记录保留。
media.loaded.en: Older photos were moved to the media library. Your entries are preserved.

media.migrationFailed.zh: 旧照片仍保留原格式。媒体迁移未完成，请先备份并检查存储空间。
media.migrationFailed.en: Older photos remain in their original format. Back up your data and check storage before retrying migration.

settings.subtitle.en: Make Little Days feel a little more you.

settings.contentNote.zh: 语言切换只影响界面，不会翻译或删除你的记录。
settings.contentNote.en: Language changes the interface, never your own words or media.

settings.storageNote.zh: 你的文字、照片、视频和声音都只保存在这台设备上，不会上传。换手机或换浏览器前，请先导出备份。
settings.storageNote.en: Your words, photos, videos and sounds stay on this device and are never uploaded. Before switching phones or browsers, export a backup.

settings.backupNote.zh: 备份文件里有你的私人文字和照片，请放在安全的地方，不要分享给别人。单次导出最多 100 MB 媒体，导入文件最大 150 MB。
settings.backupNote.en: A backup holds your private words and photos — keep it somewhere safe and don't share it. Up to 100 MB of media per export; files up to 150 MB can be restored.

lock.offHint.zh: 打开后，进入 Little Days 要输入 4 位密码（iPhone App 里也可以用面容 ID）。
lock.offHint.en: When on, a 4-digit passcode opens Little Days (or Face ID in the iPhone app).

lock.onHint.zh: 已打开。密码只保存在这台设备上（加密后的校验值，不存原密码）。关掉要先输入密码。
lock.onHint.en: On. The passcode stays on this device (stored only as a salted hash). Turning it off asks for it first.

lock.biometricHint.zh: 只在 iPhone App 里可用；验证由 iOS 完成，Little Days 拿不到你的面容或指纹信息。
lock.biometricHint.en: iPhone app only; iOS checks it — Little Days never sees your face or fingerprint.

lock.biometricReason.zh: 解锁你的 Little Days 手帐

lock.enterToOff.zh: 输入密码以关闭 App 锁
lock.enterToOff.en: Enter passcode to turn the lock off

lock.mismatch.zh: 两次不一样，请重新设置
lock.mismatch.en: They didn't match — set it again

lock.pause.zh: 试错太多次了，{seconds} 秒后再试

lock.forgotText.zh: 密码只保存在这台设备上，我们也无法帮你找回。iPhone App 里打开了面容 ID 的话可以用它解锁；否则只能清除这台设备上 Little Days 的数据（记录会一起删除，所以记得定期在设置里备份）。
lock.forgotText.en: The passcode lives only on this device, so we can't recover it. In the iPhone app, Face ID unlocks it if turned on; otherwise the only way is to clear Little Days' data on this device (which deletes the journal — so back up from Settings now and then).

storage.saveFailed.zh: 这次没能存进本机数据库，请检查手机存储空间，并尽快备份。
storage.saveFailed.en: Couldn't save to this device's database — check free space and back up soon.

backup.never.zh: 记了 {count} 天，还没备份过 · 记录只在这台手机上
backup.never.en: {count} days kept, no backup yet · it's all only on this phone

backup.whenNever.zh: 还没备份过。在 iPhone 上可以把备份文件存到「文件」或 iCloud 云盘。
backup.whenNever.en: No backup yet. On iPhone you can save the file to Files or iCloud Drive.

search.placeholder.zh: 搜索写过的字、#标签、手帐本…

search.hint.zh: 可以搜标题、正文、纸上的字、#标签、习惯感想和做完的事；几个词用空格隔开就会都匹配。只在这台设备上搜索。
search.hint.en: Search titles, words, text on the paper, #tags, habit notes and things done; several words separated by spaces must all match. Searching happens only on this device.

reminder.note.zh: 在你选的时间轻轻问一句。用 iPhone 本地通知，不联网；今天已经记过了就不打扰。
reminder.note.en: A gentle nudge at your time — a local iPhone notification, nothing online; skipped once today is kept.

reminder.appOnly.zh: 提醒只在 iPhone App 里有效：网页关掉后没法发通知。
reminder.appOnly.en: Reminders work in the iPhone app only — a closed web page can't notify you.

reminder.denied.zh: iPhone 没有允许 Little Days 发通知：请到「设置 → 通知 → Little Days」打开。
reminder.denied.en: Notifications are off for Little Days: turn them on in Settings → Notifications → Little Days.

reminder.failed.zh: 提醒没能设置好，请稍后再试。
reminder.failed.en: The reminder couldn't be set — try again later.

books.tagsPlaceholder.zh: 例如：阅读 感恩 健身

books.tagsHint.zh: 用空格分开，最多 8 个；带空格的标签前面加 #（例如 #self awareness）。书架上可以按标签找书，搜索也能搜到。
books.tagsHint.en: Separate with spaces, up to 8; put # before a tag with spaces (e.g. #self awareness). Filter the shelf by tag; search finds them too.

home.nameHint.zh: 只用在首页的问候里，保存在这台设备上。
home.nameHint.en: Used only in Home's greeting, kept on this device.

keeper.invite.title.zh: 想要一个陪你记录的小伙伴吗？
keeper.invite.title.en: Would you like a little companion for your journal?

keeper.invite.body.zh: Little Keeper 会住在你的手帐里，随你记录的日子慢慢长大。完全可选，随时可以关掉。
keeper.invite.body.en: Little Keeper lives in your journal and grows as you keep your days. Entirely optional — turn it off any time.

keeper.onboard.body.zh: 你的手帐才是主角，它只是让这段路更温暖一点。不用喂、不用照顾，也不会因为你没来而难过。
keeper.onboard.body.en: Your journal is the main character; your companion just makes the journey warmer. No feeding, no looking after, never sad when you're away.

keeper.onboard.privacy.zh: 它说的话都在这台设备上生成，你的日记不会被发送到任何地方。
keeper.onboard.privacy.en: Everything they say is made on this device; your journal is never sent anywhere.

keeper.mode.quietHint.zh: 只在旁边陪着，不说话、不打扰、不读你的日记。
keeper.mode.quietHint.en: Just there beside you — no messages, no interruptions, never reads your journal.

keeper.mode.gentleHint.zh: 轻轻邀请你记录；只有你点「听听它怎么说」时才回应那一页。
keeper.mode.gentleHint.en: A soft invitation to write; replies to a page only when you ask.

keeper.mode.interactiveHint.zh: 可以点它聊几句、一起回看和整理；翻看以前的页面、主动打招呼都要你另外打开。
keeper.mode.interactiveHint.en: Tap to chat, revisit and tidy up together; looking at earlier pages and speaking first each need your OK.

keeper.prompt.morning.zh: 早上好～今天想先记下点什么吗？
keeper.prompt.morning.en: Good morning — anything you'd like to keep from today?

keeper.prompt.afternoon.zh: 今天有什么想记住的吗？
keeper.prompt.afternoon.en: What would you like to remember about today?

keeper.prompt.evening.zh: 今天过得怎么样？想写一句也可以。
keeper.prompt.evening.en: How was today? Even one line is lovely.

keeper.prompt.night.zh: 夜深了，想把今天收进本子里吗？
keeper.prompt.night.en: It's late — shall we tuck today into the notebook?

keeper.prompt.kept.zh: 今天的页面我收好了，谢谢你。
keeper.prompt.kept.en: I've tucked today's page away. Thank you.

keeper.prompt.memory.zh: {years} 年前的今天，你写了「{title}」，要一起看看吗？
keeper.prompt.memory.en: {years} year(s) ago today you wrote “{title}” — want to look together?

keeper.grew.zh: 我好像长大了一点点 —— {stage}。谢谢你记下的每一天。
keeper.grew.en: I think I've grown a little — {stage}. Thank you for every day you kept.

keeper.tap.1.zh: 我在帮你看着这些本子。

keeper.tap.2.en: It's okay not to write today, too.

keeper.tap.3.zh: 你的手帐越来越好看了。

keeper.turnedOff.zh: Little Keeper 已关闭，你的记录都还在。
keeper.turnedOff.en: Little Keeper is off — all your pages are still here.

keeper.localNote.zh: 这句话是在这台设备上生成的，这一页没有被发送到任何地方。
keeper.localNote.en: Made on this device — this page wasn't sent anywhere.

keeper.shelf.count.zh: 这里有你的 {count} 本手帐，我都帮你看着。
keeper.shelf.count.en: {count} journals here — I'm keeping an eye on them all.

keeper.shelf.tidy.zh: 给手帐本加个标签，找起来会更快哦。
keeper.shelf.tidy.en: Tags make journals quicker to find.

keeper.chip.week.en: What did I write this week?

keeper.chat.hello.zh: 我在呢。想一起回看，还是整理一下书架？
keeper.chat.hello.en: I'm here. Shall we look back, or tidy the shelf?

keeper.chat.heard.zh: 嗯，我听到了。想把它写进今天的一页吗？
keeper.chat.heard.en: I hear you. Would you like to write it into today's page?

keeper.chat.needMemories.zh: 我还没有翻看你以前页面的许可。如果愿意，可以在设置 → Little Keeper 里打开「翻看以前的页面」。
keeper.chat.needMemories.en: I don't have permission to look at your earlier pages. If you'd like, turn on “Look at earlier pages” in Settings → Little Keeper.

keeper.chat.noMemories.zh: 以前的页面还不多，我们慢慢攒。
keeper.chat.noMemories.en: Not many earlier pages yet — we'll collect them slowly.

keeper.chat.weekNone.zh: 这周还没有记录，没关系，想写的时候再写。
keeper.chat.weekNone.en: Nothing kept this week yet — that's fine, write when you feel like it.

keeper.chat.weekTitles.en: You kept {count} day(s) this week, including “{titles}”.

keeper.chat.shelfTags.zh: 你有 {count} 本手帐，其中 {untagged} 本还没有标签。要不要给它们加几个？
keeper.chat.shelfTags.en: You have {count} journals; {untagged} have no tags yet. Want to add a few?

keeper.chat.shelfTidy.zh: 你的 {count} 本手帐都有标签了，整整齐齐。
keeper.chat.shelfTidy.en: All {count} of your journals have tags — neat and tidy.

keeper.chat.privacyOn.zh: 可以翻看你以前的页面（只在这台设备上）。随时可以在设置里关掉。
keeper.chat.privacyOn.en: May look at your earlier pages (on this device only). Turn it off any time in Settings.

keeper.chat.privacyOff.zh: 不会翻看你以前的页面；聊天不会被保存或发送。
keeper.chat.privacyOff.en: Doesn't look at your earlier pages; the chat isn't saved or sent.

keeper.settings.offNote.zh: 一个可选的小伙伴，随你记录的日子慢慢长大。关着的时候不会出现在任何地方。
keeper.settings.offNote.en: An optional little companion who grows as you keep your days. While off, it appears nowhere.

keeper.settings.growthNote.zh: 它随你记录的日子慢慢长大：写一页、放进照片、照顾自己、回看回忆、把记录收进手帐本。每天最多长一点点；难过的日子和开心的日子一样算；没来也不会退步。
keeper.settings.growthNote.en: They grow with the days you keep: writing a page, adding photos, looking after yourself, revisiting memories, filling your journals. A little at most each day; sad and happy days count the same; nothing is lost when you're away.

keeper.settings.allowMemoriesHint.zh: 让它在聊天里帮你回看以前的页面（只在这台设备上）。
keeper.settings.allowMemoriesHint.en: Lets them revisit earlier pages with you in chat (on this device only).

keeper.settings.proactiveHint.zh: 在首页偶尔主动提起「那年今天」。需要同时打开「翻看以前的页面」。
keeper.settings.proactiveHint.en: Now and then mention “On this day” on Home. Needs “Look at earlier pages” too.

keeper.settings.aiConsent.zh: 允许发送给 AI 服务
keeper.settings.aiConsent.en: Allow sending to an AI service

keeper.settings.aiConsentHint.zh: 还没有接入安全的 AI 服务，所以这里不能打开；现在的回应都在这台设备上生成，不会发送你的日记。
keeper.settings.aiConsentHint.en: No secure AI service is connected, so this stays off; replies are made on this device and your journal is never sent.

keeper.settings.offKeeps.zh: 关闭只会让它不再出现，你的记录、名字和设置都会保留。
keeper.settings.offKeeps.en: Turning off only hides them; your pages, its name and settings are kept.

privacy.factDevice.zh: 文字、照片、视频和声音只存在这台设备上，没有账号服务器，也不会上传。
privacy.factDevice.en: Words, photos, videos and sounds stay on this device: no account server, nothing uploaded.

privacy.factPhotos.zh: 放进来的照片会重新存一份，拍摄地点（GPS）等照片信息不会留下；只读一下拍摄时间，用来排序和补记。
privacy.factPhotos.en: Photos you add are saved anew without their location (GPS) and other photo details; only the time taken is read, to order them and fill in a day.

privacy.factNothingSent.zh: App 不连接任何第三方服务，没有广告和统计追踪；测试记录只记次数，不含内容，只有你导出时才离开设备。
privacy.factNothingSent.en: The app talks to no third-party service — no ads, no tracking; the test log counts taps only, with no content, and leaves the device only if you export it.

privacy.factDemo.zh: 社区、好友、私信、共同创作目前是本机演示，不会发出任何内容。
privacy.factDemo.en: Community, friends, messages and shared books are a local demo for now and send nothing.

privacy.hideTodayHint.zh: 首页「今天」卡片不显示照片和文字，只显示记了几页；别人看到你的手机时更安心。
privacy.hideTodayHint.en: Home's “Today” card shows no photos or words, only how many pages; handy when someone else sees your phone.

privacy.shareList.zh: 导出和分享时附上今日清单

privacy.shareListHint.zh: 默认不附：打卡的习惯和做完的事是私人的。打开后，导出的图片和分享给家人的 PDF 会在当天第一页下面带上它。
privacy.shareListHint.en: Off by default: habits and things done are private. Turn on to add it under a day's first page in exported pictures and shared PDFs.

privacy.hiddenHint.zh: 照片和文字已在首页隐藏 · 点开查看
privacy.hiddenHint.en: Photos and words hidden on Home · tap to open

settings.private.zh: 默认私人 · 无联网社交
settings.private.en: Private by default · no online social features

settings.privateNote.zh: 手帐默认只有你自己能看。社区、好友、私信和共同创作目前是本机演示，不会把任何内容发出去；换封面或主题也不会公开内容。
settings.privateNote.en: Your journal is private by default. Community, friends, messages and shared books are a local demo for now and send nothing anywhere; changing a cover or theme never publishes anything.

settings.licensesNote.zh: 字体使用 SIL OFL；贴纸为本项目原创。可点击查看随仓库保留的许可证。
settings.licensesNote.en: Fonts use SIL OFL; stickers are original project artwork. License notices are included locally.

dialog.habitDescription.zh: 为喜欢的自己，种下一颗小种子。主题可以自定义。
dialog.habitDescription.en: Plant a seed for the person you want to be. Choose any theme.

dialog.minutes.zh: 默认时长（分钟，时长型适用）

error.generic.zh: 操作未保存，请检查浏览器存储空间后重试。
error.generic.en: Changes were not saved. Check available browser storage and retry.

error.start.en: The stationery shop could not open

error.startHelp.zh: 请通过 localhost 启动，并允许浏览器本地存储。已有记录不会自动清除。
error.startHelp.en: Start through localhost and allow local storage. Existing records will not be cleared.

保存失败：浏览器空间不足，请先导出图片或备份记录。.zh: 保存失败：浏览器空间不足，请先导出图片或备份记录。
保存失败：浏览器空间不足，请先导出图片或备份记录。.en: Save failed: browser storage is full. Export a backup before continuing.

草稿未保存，请勿关闭页面.zh: 草稿未保存，请勿关闭页面
草稿未保存，请勿关闭页面.en: Draft not saved. Keep this page open.

收集到一份小小的成长 🌱.zh: 收集到一份小小的成长 🌱

草稿已保存，下次从 Studio 继续。.zh: 草稿已保存，下次打开「创作」就能接着写。
草稿已保存，下次从 Studio 继续。.en: Draft saved — pick it up next time in Studio.

先留下一张照片，或者写点什么吧。.zh: 先留下一张照片，或者写点什么吧。
先留下一张照片，或者写点什么吧。.en: Add a photo, a note, or a media moment first.

手帐图片已导出（基础排版版本）。.zh: 手帐图片已导出（基础排版版本）。

操作未保存，请检查浏览器存储空间后重试。.zh: 操作未保存，请检查浏览器存储空间后重试。
操作未保存，请检查浏览器存储空间后重试。.en: Changes were not saved. Check browser storage and retry.

旧草稿未保存，暂不能切换日期。.zh: 旧草稿未保存，暂不能切换日期。
旧草稿未保存，暂不能切换日期。.en: The previous draft could not save. Please stay on this date.

成长已记录，也已关联当天日期 🌱.zh: 成长已记录，也已关联当天日期 🌱
成长已记录，也已关联当天日期 🌱.en: Growth saved and linked to this date 🌱

新的小期待，已准备好。.en: A little new beginning is ready.

保存失败，请检查本机存储空间。.zh: 保存失败，请检查本机存储空间。
保存失败，请检查本机存储空间。.en: Could not save. Check available storage.

native.readError.zh: 本机记录无法读取。为保护原文件，已暂停保存，请先备份 state.json。
native.readError.en: Local records could not be read. Saving is paused to protect the original file. Back up state.json first.

native.backupFirst.zh: 请先恢复或备份已有记录。
native.backupFirst.en: Restore or back up your existing records first.

native.saveFailed.zh: 本机保存失败，请检查可用空间后重试。
native.saveFailed.en: Local save failed. Check available space and retry.

native.editorScope.zh: 原生编辑器目前支持文字、心情、模板、授权字体与本机保存。视频/音频、封面编辑和自由贴纸等将继续与 Web 对齐。
native.editorScope.en: The native editor supports text, mood, templates, licensed fonts and local saves. Video/audio, cover editing and free stickers will be aligned with the Web preview in a later step.

error.bookRequired.zh: 请填写手帐本名称和主题。
error.bookRequired.en: Enter a book name and theme.

error.fieldsLimit.zh: 一本手帐本最多支持 20 个自定义字段。
error.fieldsLimit.en: A book supports up to 20 custom fields.

error.invalidField.zh: 请填写有效的字段名称和类型。
error.invalidField.en: Enter valid field labels and types.

error.selectOptions.zh: 单选字段需要 1–20 个选项，以逗号分隔。

error.conflict.zh: 另一窗口已更新记录，当前改动没有覆盖它。请保留此页，先复制文字或导出当前图片，再刷新。
error.conflict.en: Another tab updated your records. Your changes did not overwrite them. Keep this tab open, copy your text or export the current image, then reload.

settings.restoreConfirm.zh: 恢复将替换此浏览器的当前记录。请先导出当前备份。确认恢复所选文件吗？
settings.restoreConfirm.en: Restoring replaces the records in this browser. Export your current backup first. Restore the selected file?

settings.restoreDone.zh: 记录和媒体已恢复，所有手帐保持私人。
settings.restoreDone.en: Records and media restored. All journals remain private.

settings.restoreFailed.zh: 备份未恢复，当前记录保留。请使用完整的 Little Days 备份文件。
settings.restoreFailed.en: Backup was not restored. Current records are preserved. Choose a complete Little Days backup file.

error.invalidData.zh: 记录或备份格式不兼容，现有资料不会自动清除。
error.invalidData.en: Records or backup format is incompatible. Existing data will not be cleared.

error.backupSize.zh: 当前完整备份最多包含 100 MB 媒体。记录已保留，请保留大文件原件；分卷备份将在后续完善。
error.backupSize.en: Full backups currently support up to 100 MB of media. Your records are preserved. Keep original large files; split backups will come later.

本地记录格式不兼容，请先备份浏览器数据。.zh: 本地记录格式不兼容，请先备份浏览器数据。
本地记录格式不兼容，请先备份浏览器数据。.en: Local records are incompatible. Back up your browser data before continuing.

day.draftPending.zh: 这一天还有尚未正式保存的草稿。
day.draftPending.en: This day also has an unsaved draft.

day.draftOnly.zh: 以下是尚未正式保存的草稿内容。

moment.caption.zh: 封面用一句话总结这一天，每一页记录一件事。
moment.caption.en: The cover sums up the day; each page keeps one thing.

moment.dayHint.zh: 当天的标题、主照片与正文
moment.dayHint.en: Title, main photo and notes for the day

moment.bodyPlaceholder.zh: 写下这一刻发生了什么…

moment.tagsPlaceholder.zh: 用逗号分隔，例如：周末, 散步

moment.savedToast.en: This page is saved on its own

moment.deleteConfirm.zh: 删除这一页？照片和录音文件仍保留在本机，可撤销。
moment.deleteConfirm.en: Delete this page? Its media files stay on this device and you can undo.

moment.deleted.zh: 这一页已删除，可以撤销。

moment.canvasHint.zh: 点一下，添加照片、文字、视频或声音
moment.canvasHint.en: Tap to add a photo, text, video or sound

photo.partial.zh: 已加入 {saved} 张，{failed} 张无法读取

photo.cropHelp.zh: 裁切中：拖动照片移动画面，双指或滚轮缩放。
photo.cropHelp.en: Cropping: drag to pan inside the frame; pinch or scroll to zoom.

layer.gestureHelp.zh: 拖动移动；双指缩放与旋转；鼠标可拖右下角调整大小、拖顶部圆点旋转，滚轮缩放（Shift 旋转），方向键微调。
layer.gestureHelp.en: Drag to move; pinch to scale and rotate. With a mouse, drag the corner to resize, the top dot to rotate, scroll to scale (Shift rotates), arrow keys nudge.

layout.confirm.zh: 你已经手动调整过照片位置。套用模板会重新排列所有照片（可撤销），继续吗？
layout.confirm.en: You have arranged photos by hand. Applying a template rearranges every photo (you can undo). Continue?

growth.detailPlaceholder.zh: 简单写一句今天做了什么
growth.detailPlaceholder.en: A few words about what you did

growth.notePlaceholder.zh: 今天有什么感受或小进步？
growth.notePlaceholder.en: How did it feel? Any small progress?

growth.shareNote.zh: 将来分享手帐时，允许显示这条感想
growth.shareNote.en: Allow this note in journals I share later

growth.privateNote.zh: 感想默认私人。目前没有公开分享功能；即使将来分享相关手帐，也只有勾选的感想才可能显示。
growth.privateNote.en: Notes are private by default. Sharing is not available yet; even later, only notes you tick here could be shown.

growth.noteSaved.zh: 感想已保存，打卡次数不变 🌱
growth.noteSaved.en: Note saved; your check-in count is unchanged 🌱

growth.cancelConfirm.zh: 这次打卡有感想或照片。取消打卡会一起删除它们，确定吗？
growth.cancelConfirm.en: This check-in has a note or photo. Cancelling it removes them too. Continue?

growth.insertHelp.zh: 插入后会显示原始打卡与感想；修改感想会同步更新，删除手帐页不会删除打卡。
growth.insertHelp.en: Cards show the original check-in; editing the note updates the card, and deleting a page never deletes the check-in.

growth.insertedToast.en: Growth card added to the page

reflection.caption.zh: 写给自己的小便签，不需要每次都填写。
reflection.caption.en: Little notes to yourself — always optional.

reflection.prompt.zh: 做得好的事、遇到的困难、学到的东西、下次想改进的地方。
reflection.prompt.en: What went well, what was hard, what you learned, what to try next.

settings.usage.zh: 当前引用的本机媒体：{count} 个，约 {size} MB（完整备份的媒体上限 100 MB）。
settings.usage.en: Media referenced on this device: {count} files, about {size} MB (full backups include up to 100 MB of media).

settings.usageUnknown.zh: 暂时无法统计本机媒体大小。
settings.usageUnknown.en: Media usage could not be measured right now.

photo.toolHelp.zh: 可一次选多张；添加后在「排版」里一键套用版式，或在上方预览里直接拖动。
photo.toolHelp.en: Pick several at once, then choose a layout under Layout or drag them in the preview above.

layout.help.zh: 点一个版式，上方预览会立刻变化；之后仍可拖动每张照片。
layout.help.en: Tap a layout and the preview above updates right away; you can still drag each photo.

layout.needPhotos.zh: 先添加照片，就能在这里选择版式。
layout.needPhotos.en: Add photos first to choose a layout here.

studio.previewLarge.en: Close the panel and enlarge the page

journey.empty.zh: 还没有打卡。打卡后，每一天都会成为这本小书的一页。
journey.empty.en: No check-ins yet. Each check-in becomes a page of this little book.

journey.hint.zh: 左右滑动或点 ‹ › 翻页，也可以在下方目录直接打开某一天。
journey.hint.en: Swipe or tap ‹ › to turn pages, or open a day from the contents below.

journey.missing.en: This habit could not be found.

write.decorateHint.zh: 版式、照片、字体、纸张…点开一项就能看到变化
write.decorateHint.en: Layout, photos, font, paper… open one and watch the page change

layout.hasPhotos.zh: 这一页已经有 {count} 张照片

layout.textHelp.zh: 不放照片，标题和文字会直接排在纸上。
layout.textHelp.en: No photos: the title and words are set on the paper.

layout.slotHelp.zh: 预览里会出现空相框，点「加照片」就会按顺序放进去；之后仍可拖动。
layout.slotHelp.en: Empty frames appear in the preview; tap Photos to fill them in order. You can still drag them later.

layout.textHasPhotos.zh: 这一页已经有照片，不能改成只有文字。
layout.textHasPhotos.en: This page has photos, so it can't be words only.

moment.ctaDay.en: Add a page to this day

moment.ctaHint.zh: 照片 + 一句话、随手写，或者手绘
moment.ctaHint.en: Photo + a line, just write, or draw

community.subtitle.zh: 看看别人的小日子，也分享你愿意分享的那一页。
community.subtitle.en: See other little days, and share only what you choose.

community.demoLabel.zh: 演示 · 本机模拟 · 未联网
community.demoLabel.en: Demo · simulated on this device · offline

community.demoNote.zh: 这里的用户、作品、好友和消息都是虚拟的演示数据，只保存在这个浏览器里；不会上传你的手帐，也不会真的公开任何内容。
community.demoNote.en: Users, works, friends and messages here are virtual demo data kept in this browser only. Nothing is uploaded and nothing becomes public.

community.homeHint.zh: 发现、关注、好友与私信（本机演示，未联网）
community.homeHint.en: Discover, follow, friends and messages (offline demo)

community.resetConfirm.zh: 把社区演示数据恢复成初始状态？你的手帐不受影响。
community.resetConfirm.en: Reset the community demo? Your journal is not affected.

community.saveFailed.zh: 演示数据保存失败，请检查浏览器存储空间。
community.saveFailed.en: Demo data could not be saved. Check browser storage.

community.followingEmpty.zh: 关注作者后，他们的新作品会出现在这里。
community.followingEmpty.en: Follow creators to see their new work here.

community.popularHow.zh: 按点赞、评论、收藏和发布时间综合排序。
community.popularHow.en: Ranked by likes, comments, saves and how recent it is.

community.searchPlaceholder.zh: 搜索作品、主题或创作者

community.missing.zh: 这个作品已不在社区中。
community.missing.en: This work is no longer in the community.

community.mediaCount.zh: 包含 {count} 段音频/视频（演示中只显示数量）
community.mediaCount.en: Includes {count} audio/video clips (demo shows the count only)

community.shareText.zh: Little Days 演示作品：{title}（本机演示，没有真实链接）
community.shareText.en: Little Days demo work: {title} (offline demo, no real link)

community.reported.zh: 已记录举报（演示，不会发送）

community.saved.zh: 已收藏（只是收藏引用，不会复制作品）

community.saveNote.zh: 收藏只是记下这份作品；复制编辑他人作品需要作者授权并保留来源（演示中不提供复制）。
community.saveNote.en: Saving only bookmarks the work. Copying someone's work needs their permission and credit (not offered in the demo).

community.unpublishConfirm.zh: 把这篇撤回为私人？社区里将不再显示。
community.unpublishConfirm.en: Make this private again? It will leave the community.

community.unpublished.zh: 已撤回，只有你自己能看到。

community.moreComments.zh: 还有 {count} 条较早的评论

community.followVsFriendsText.zh: 关注是单向的，只看对方公开的作品；好友需要双方确认，可以互发私信。成为好友也不会看到对方的私人手帐。
community.followVsFriendsText.en: Following is one-way and shows public work only. Friends confirm each other and can message. Being friends never opens private journals.

community.removeConfirm.zh: 删除这位好友？之后不能再互发私信。
community.removeConfirm.en: Remove this friend? You won't be able to message each other.

community.blockConfirm.zh: 屏蔽后将不再看到对方的作品，也不能互发消息或好友申请。
community.blockConfirm.en: Blocking hides their work and stops messages and friend requests.

community.deleteChatConfirm.zh: 删除这个会话？只会删除你这边的记录。
community.deleteChatConfirm.en: Delete this chat? Only your copy is removed.

community.chatNote.zh: 对方的回复是本机模拟的演示消息。
community.chatNote.en: Replies are simulated on this device.

community.friendsOnly.zh: 只有互相确认的好友才能私信。
community.friendsOnly.en: Only confirmed friends can message each other.

community.sim2.zh: 收到啦～周末一起去？（模拟回复）

community.sim3.zh: 哈哈哈太可爱了（模拟回复）

community.publishStart.zh: 选择一天发布到社区（演示）
community.publishStart.en: Publish a day to the community (demo)

community.privateDefault.zh: 你的手帐默认私人。只有你在下面逐项勾选并确认的页面和媒体才会出现在社区演示里。
community.privateDefault.en: Your journal stays private. Only pages and media you tick and confirm appear in the demo community.

community.noWorks.zh: 你还没有发布任何作品。

community.publishTitle.zh: 发布前确认要分享的内容

community.publishHelp.zh: 默认什么都不勾选。照片、录音和视频需要逐个勾选；记账类内容不能公开；成长感想只有你单独允许过才可能出现。
community.publishHelp.en: Nothing is selected by default. Tick each photo, recording or video; money records can't be shared; growth notes appear only if you allowed them.

community.nothingToShare.zh: 这一天没有可以分享的页面。
community.nothingToShare.en: Nothing on this day can be shared.

community.moneyLocked.zh: 记账/金额类内容默认私人，不能公开

community.confirmPublish.zh: 我已检查以上页面和媒体，确认可以公开（演示）
community.confirmPublish.en: I've checked these pages and media and want to share them (demo)

community.published.zh: 已发布到社区演示（没有上传，只在本机）
community.published.en: Published to the demo community (offline, this device only)

community.notOwner.en: You can only change your own content.

community.requestsWaiting.zh: 另有 {count} 个申请来自你没有关注的人，按你的设置暂不显示。
community.requestsWaiting.en: {count} more requests from people you don't follow are hidden by your setting.

community.peopleSearch.zh: 搜索创作者的名字或 @账号

community.bioPlaceholder.zh: 比如：记录早餐、散步和慢慢变好的自己
community.bioPlaceholder.en: e.g. Breakfasts, walks and growing gently

community.defaultComments.zh: 新发布的作品默认允许评论
community.defaultComments.en: Allow comments on new posts by default

community.whoCanRequest.zh: 谁可以向我发送好友申请
community.whoCanRequest.en: Who can send me friend requests

community.messagesFriendsOnly.zh: 私信始终只对互相确认的好友开放；成为好友也不会看到你的私人手帐。
community.messagesFriendsOnly.en: Messages are always friends-only, and friends never see your private journals.

home.prompt.en: What would you like to keep from today?

export.recording.zh: 已录制 {now} / {total}，请保持页面打开
export.recording.en: Recorded {now} of {total} — keep this page open

export.videoDone.zh: 视频已导出，纸上的视频和声音都在里面。
export.videoDone.en: Video exported with the clips and sound from the page.

export.videoFailed.zh: 视频导出失败，请重试；这个浏览器可能不支持录制。
export.videoFailed.en: Video export failed. Try again; this browser may not support recording.

export.videoUnsupported.zh: 这个浏览器不支持导出视频。

layout.textConfirm.zh: 改成“只有文字”？这一页的照片会从纸上移开（照片文件仍保存在本机，可以撤销）。
layout.textConfirm.en: Switch to words only? Photos leave this page (the files stay on this device, and you can undo).

export.cancelled.zh: 已取消导出，没有生成文件。
export.cancelled.en: Export cancelled; no file was made.

growth.none.zh: 还没有小习惯，先种下一颗吧。
growth.none.en: No habits yet — plant your first one.

collab.demoNote.zh: 成员是虚拟好友，邀请、回复和修改都只在这个浏览器里模拟，不会发送给任何人。上面你自己的私人页面不会被共享。
collab.demoNote.en: Members are virtual friends; invites, replies and edits are simulated in this browser only and sent to no one. Your own private pages above are never shared.

collab.noFriends.zh: 只能邀请好友；好友也不会自动看到你的手帐。
collab.noFriends.en: Only friends can be invited, and friends never see your journal automatically.

collab.removeConfirm.zh: 把 {name} 移出这本共同手帐？TA 写过的页面会保留并标注作者。
collab.removeConfirm.en: Remove {name} from this shared book? Pages they wrote stay, still marked with their name.

collab.leftToast.zh: {name} 退出了（模拟），TA 写的页面仍保留

collab.accepted.zh: {name} 接受了邀请，并写了一页（模拟）

collab.noPages.zh: 还没有共同页面。邀请好友，或先写下第一页。
collab.noPages.en: No shared pages yet. Invite a friend or write the first one.

collab.conflictBody.zh: 你和 {name} 同时改了这一页。两边的文字都保留着，请选择怎么处理。
collab.conflictBody.en: You and {name} edited this page at the same time. Both texts are kept — choose what to do.

collab.resolved.zh: 已处理，记录在版本历史里
collab.resolved.en: Resolved and saved in version history

collab.restoreConfirm.zh: 恢复到这个版本？现在的内容也会作为一个新版本保留，可以再恢复回来。
collab.restoreConfirm.en: Restore this version? The current pages are kept as a version too, so you can switch back.

collab.restored.zh: 已恢复（现在的内容也留在历史里）
collab.restored.en: Restored (the previous pages stay in history)

collab.publishNeeds.zh: 需要全部 {count} 位成员同意才能公开 · 未开放
collab.publishNeeds.en: Needs consent from all {count} members · not available yet

collab.publishSolo.zh: 公开需要服务端权限控制 · 未开放
collab.publishSolo.en: Publishing needs server access control · not available yet

collab.dialogNote.zh: 只保存在这个浏览器的演示数据里
collab.dialogNote.en: Saved only in this browser's demo data

collab.saved.zh: 已保存，并记录了一个版本

collab.already.zh: TA 已经在这本手帐里了

collab.viewerOnly.zh: 只能看的成员不能编辑

collab.noEditor.zh: 需要一位已加入的可编辑成员，才能模拟同时编辑
collab.noEditor.en: Needs a joined editor to simulate a clash

me.subtitle.zh: 你的小日子都是私人的；想分享时，在这里决定谁能看到什么。
me.subtitle.en: Your days stay private; when you want to share, decide here who sees what.

me.demoNote.zh: 社交部分是本机演示：头像、展示的封面和发布都只保存在这个浏览器，不会上传，也不会真的公开。
me.demoNote.en: The social part is a local demo: your avatar, shown covers and posts stay in this browser — nothing is uploaded or made public.

shelf.hint.zh: 轻点书脊抽出来看；按住拖动可以换位置
shelf.hint.en: Tap a spine to pull it out; hold and drag to move it

who.help.zh: 每本手帐默认只有你自己能看。你可以选择在主页上展示某本书的封面——只展示封面和书名，里面的页面仍然只有你能看。
who.help.en: Every book is only visible to you by default. You can show a book's cover on your profile — only the cover and title; the pages inside stay yours alone.

who.collab.zh: 与 {count} 位好友共同创作 · 共同页面仅成员可见
who.collab.en: Shared with {count} friends · shared pages members-only

who.factPosts.zh: 发布到社区的作品：{count} 篇（只有你逐页勾选确认的内容）
who.factPosts.en: Posts in the community: {count} (only pages you ticked and confirmed)

who.factFriends.zh: 好友不会因此看到你的私人手帐
who.factFriends.en: Being friends never opens your private journal

who.preview.zh: 别人看到的我的主页（预览）
who.preview.en: My profile as others see it (preview)

who.previewNote.zh: 这里没有出现的内容，别人都看不到。
who.previewNote.en: Anything not shown here stays hidden from others.

who.confirm.zh: 在主页展示这本书的封面和书名？里面的页面不会展示（演示，不会真的公开）。
who.confirm.en: Show this book's cover and title on your profile? The pages inside are not shown (demo — nothing is really made public).

who.shownToast.zh: 封面已展示在主页（演示）

who.hiddenToast.zh: 这本书现在仅自己可见
who.hiddenToast.en: This book is only visible to you

login.tagline.zh: 小日子，慢慢记。记录生活的美好，也收藏一点点变好的自己。
login.tagline.en: Collect little days, gently — and a little more of you.

login.welcomeBack.zh: 欢迎回来，{name}。你的手帐都还在这台设备上。
login.welcomeBack.en: Welcome back, {name}. Your journal is still on this device.

login.note.zh: 现在是本机账号：手帐、照片和录音只保存在这台设备，不会上传。云端账号和同步需要服务端，正在开发。
login.note.en: For now this is a local account: journals, photos and recordings stay on this device and are never uploaded. Cloud accounts and sync need a server and are in progress.

login.signOutConfirm.zh: 退出登录？会回到登录页，你的手帐、照片和录音仍保存在这台设备上。
login.signOutConfirm.en: Sign out? You'll return to the sign-in page; your journal, photos and recordings stay on this device.

tour.finished.zh: 想再看一次？在「设置」里可以重看介绍。
tour.finished.en: Want to see it again? Replay the tour in Settings.

tour.welcome.body.zh: Little Days 是一本放在手机里的手帐：每天记一点点，照片、文字、声音都可以。
tour.welcome.body.en: Little Days is a journal in your pocket: a little each day — photos, words and sounds.

tour.write.body.zh: 点「＋」选怎么记：照片 + 一句话、随手写或手绘。一天可以有好几页；封面用一句话总结这一天，可以不写。
tour.write.body.en: Tap ＋ and choose: photo + a line, just write, or draw. A day can have several pages; the cover sums it up in one line (optional).

tour.photo.body.zh: 选照片后可以加滤镜、裁剪比例、调亮度和色温，还能在图上加标题文字。原图一直保留，随时重新编辑。
tour.photo.body.en: After picking photos, add filters, crop to a ratio, adjust light and warmth, and put a title on the picture. The original is kept so you can re-edit.

tour.growth.body.zh: 首页「今天」卡片里一点就打卡，打过的会出现在当天的「今日清单」上；成长之书和每周回顾在书架的「我的习惯」里。
tour.growth.body.en: Check a habit with one tap on Home's “today” card; it shows on that day's list. The growth journey and weekly reflections live in “My habits” on the shelf.

tour.shelf.body.zh: 手帐本放在书架上，轻点书脊就能抽出来看。旁边的“我的主页”决定别人能看到什么。
tour.shelf.body.en: Your books stand on a shelf — tap a spine to pull one out. “My profile” next to it decides what others can see.

tour.private.body.zh: 所有手帐默认只有你能看。社区、好友和共同创作目前是本机演示；在「设置」里可以导出备份。
tour.private.body.en: Every journal is private by default. Community, friends and shared books are a local demo for now; export a backup in Settings.

settings.accountLocal.zh: 本机账号 · 数据只在这台设备
settings.accountLocal.en: Local account · data stays on this device

settings.signOutNote.zh: 退出不会删除任何手帐、照片或录音。
settings.signOutNote.en: Signing out never deletes your journal, photos or recordings.

pe.saved.zh: 图片已更新，原图仍保留
pe.saved.en: Photo updated — the original is kept

pe.cropHint.zh: 拖动图片，选择要保留的部分
pe.cropHint.en: Drag the photo to choose what stays in the frame

pe.textHint.en: Drag the text to place it

start.title.en: How do you want to start?

start.newMoment.zh: 下面的方式会新建一个小故事，不会改动已经写好的内容。
start.newMoment.en: The options below start a new little story; nothing you wrote is changed.

start.photosHint.zh: 选几张，加滤镜、裁剪、写标题
start.photosHint.en: Pick a few; filter, crop, add a title

start.wordsHint.en: One sentence is a page too

start.videoHint.zh: 视频直接贴在纸上播放
start.videoHint.en: It plays right on the paper

start.templateHint.en: Choose how many photos, then a layout

start.growthHint.zh: 把今天的打卡贴进手帐
start.growthHint.en: Put today's check-in on the page

start.idea.happy.en: One thing that made me smile

theme.note.zh: 只改变 App 的颜色；手帐的纸张、封面和照片保持原样。只保存在这台设备。
theme.note.en: Changes the app's colors only; your paper, covers and photos stay as they are. Saved on this device.

tour.theme.body.zh: 温柔、简约、优雅、清新、樱花，或者深色的酷炫。之后在「设置」里随时可以换。
tour.theme.body.en: Soft, minimal, elegant, fresh, sakura — or the dark neon night. Change it any time in Settings.

layer.gestureHelpTouch.zh: 拖动移动，双指缩放和旋转。
layer.gestureHelpTouch.en: Drag to move; pinch to resize and rotate.

poster.help.zh: 拖动滑块选一帧当封面，或者上传一张自己的图片。
poster.help.en: Slide to pick a frame, or upload a picture of your own.

poster.failed.zh: 这一帧取不出来，换一帧或上传图片试试。
poster.failed.en: Couldn't grab that frame — try another one or upload a picture.

media.unsupported.zh: 这个视频格式在当前浏览器里不能播放，可以转成 MP4 后再上传。
media.unsupported.en: This video format can't play in this browser — convert it to MP4 and upload again.

photo.broken.zh: 这张照片在这台设备上无法显示，可以点“替换照片”重新选择。
photo.broken.en: This photo can't be shown on this device — use “Replace photo” to pick it again.

layer.barHint.zh: 复制、置顶、删除和编辑在纸上选中内容上方的小工具条里。
layer.barHint.en: Copy, to front, delete and edit are in the small bar above the selected item.

growth.checkedHint.zh: 打卡啦 🌱 想写心得、加照片，点旁边的 ✎
growth.checkedHint.en: Checked in 🌱 Tap ✎ to add a note or photo

scene.note.zh: 按心情和事件分好的真实照片，选一张最能代表今天的。放上去后还能用“编辑图片”加滤镜和文字。
scene.note.en: Real photos sorted by mood and moment — pick the one that sums up today. Then “Edit photo” for filters and words.

scene.pick.zh: 或者从照片素材里挑一张
scene.pick.en: Or pick from the photo library

level.rule.activeDay.en: Each day you wrote or checked in

level.note.zh: 经验只根据这台设备上你自己写的内容计算，示例内容不算，也不会上传。
level.note.en: XP is worked out from what you wrote on this device (samples don't count) and is never uploaded.

inbox.system.welcome.zh: 欢迎来到 Little Days！每天记一点点，就是很好的开始。
inbox.system.welcome.en: Welcome to Little Days! A little every day is a lovely start.

inbox.system.backup.zh: 小提醒：手帐只保存在这台设备上，记得在「设置」里定期导出备份。
inbox.system.backup.en: Tip: your journal lives on this device — export a backup in Settings now and then.

calendar.wallStats.zh: 这个月记录了 {days} 天 · {pictures} 张照片

choose.albumMany.zh: 可以一次选好几张，之后能修图
choose.albumMany.en: Pick several at once, then edit them

choose.albumOne.en: One for the main picture spot

note.startHint.zh: 像备忘录一样，点开就写

note.help.zh: 保存后会成为今天的一个小故事，之后可以再加照片和装饰。
note.help.en: It becomes a little story on today's page; add pictures later if you like.

note.saved.zh: 已记下，放进了今天的手帐 ✿

backdrop.note.zh: 风景照片、渐变和可爱图案铺满整页，文字会放在一块磨砂卡片上。
backdrop.note.en: Scenery photos, gradients and cute patterns across the whole page; the words sit on a frosted card.

backdrop.linkHint.zh: 风景照片、渐变、可爱图案……

mode.noteOn.en: Just write: tap the paper and type

mode.layoutOn.zh: 自由排版：文字变成了可以拖动的文字框
mode.layoutOn.en: Free layout: your words are now a box you can move

write.noteTip.zh: 标题和内容直接写在上面的纸上，点一下就能打字。
write.noteTip.en: The title and words are on the paper above — tap it and type.

write.pageName.zh: 这一页的名字 · 显示在目录和日历里
write.pageName.en: Page name · shown in the contents and calendar

write.caption.zh: 页面下方的说明 · 可选，不会写到纸上
write.caption.en: Caption under the page · optional, not on the paper

write.layoutTip.zh: 想在纸上写字：点「文字」加一个文字框，再点一下就能直接打字。
write.layoutTip.en: To write on the paper: tap Text to add a box, then tap it again to type.

books.coverPhotoPick.zh: 封面照片（也可以上传自己的）

home.booksHint.en: Pick a journal and keep going

space.booksNote.zh: 从书架挑一本“出书”：别人只看到封面和书名，里面的页面不公开。
space.booksNote.en: Pick a journal from your shelf to put out: others see only the cover and title, never the pages.

space.demoNote.zh: 空间、出书和动态都只在这台设备上演示，未真正公开。
space.demoNote.en: Your space, books and posts are a demo on this device; nothing is really public.

space.manage.zh: 只有你能看到 · 管理我的主页
space.manage.en: Only you see this · manage your page

space.otherNote.zh: 虚拟用户的主页，关注、加好友和私信都只在这台设备上模拟。
space.otherNote.en: A demo person: following, friend requests and messages are simulated on this device.

write.clearDayConfirm.zh: 清空封面的一句话和照片？这一天的每一页都会保留，可以撤销。
write.clearDayConfirm.en: Clear the cover's line and photo? Every page of the day stays, and you can undo.

books.oursEmpty.zh: 还没有共同的书。打开一本书，在「共同创作」里邀请好友一起写（本机演示）。
books.oursEmpty.en: No books with friends yet. Open a book and invite friends under Write together (demo).

way.photoHint.zh: 挑一张好看的照片，写一句话
way.photoHint.en: A lovely photo and one sentence

way.writeHint.en: Like a note: tap and type

way.drawHint.zh: 用手指或 Apple Pencil 画

mode.lineOn.zh: 照片就是这一页，写一句话吧
mode.lineOn.en: The photo is the page — add one line

draw.hint.zh: 直接在这一页上画。用 Apple Pencil 时会按力度变粗细，手掌碰到屏幕也不会画上。画好后可以移动、缩放，也能接着画。
draw.hint.en: Draw right on the page. With Apple Pencil, pressing harder draws thicker and your palm won't leave marks. Afterwards you can move, resize or draw more.

draw.saved.zh: 手绘已经放在这一页上
draw.saved.en: Your drawing is on the page

line.chooseTitle.en: Choose the photo for this page

space.dressNote.zh: 改动马上生效，别人来看时就是这个样子（本机演示）。
space.dressNote.en: Changes show right away — this is what visitors see (demo on this device).

cover.hint.zh: 封面：用一句话（和一张照片）总结这一天，可以不写。下面的「第 01 页」起记录发生了什么。
cover.hint.en: Cover: the day in one line (and a photo) — optional. Pages 01, 02… keep what happened.

pages.help.zh: 封面是这一天的一句话总结（可以不写）；下面每一页记录一件事，可以调整顺序或删除。
pages.help.en: The cover is the day in one line (optional); each page below keeps one thing — reorder or delete them here.

layout.smartHint.zh: 横的竖的都不裁掉，可以换三种样子
layout.smartHint.en: Keeps every photo's shape; three looks to shuffle

result.help.zh: 不喜欢这个排法就点「换一种」；想自己摆放、加贴纸就点「编辑」。
result.help.en: Not quite right? Shuffle. Want to arrange it yourself or add stickers? Tap Edit.

testlog.note.zh: 只在这台设备上记录用了哪些功能、用了多久，不含文字、照片和名字。参加测试时可以导出发给我们。
testlog.note.en: Kept only on this device: which features you used and how long they took — no words, photos or names. If you're testing, you can export it and send it to us.

labs.note.zh: 正在测试核心体验时，这些功能先收起来：社区和私信、我的主页与装扮、等级、共同的书、颜色主题、登录页。打开后会重新出现；数据一直保留在这台设备上。
labs.note.en: While we test the core, these are tucked away: community and messages, my profile and decorating, levels, shared books, colour themes and the sign-in page. Turn them back on here; their data stays on this device.

share.saved.zh: 已保存一张 Story 尺寸（9:16）的图片

news.dotLabel.zh: 设置 · 有新版本 V{version}

habits.none.zh: 还没有习惯 · 想养成时再加
habits.none.en: None yet · add one when you like

news.current.zh: 当前版本 V{version}。每次更新改了什么，都在这里。
news.current.en: You're on V{version}. Every update's changes are listed here.

bookShare.help.zh: 把整本书做成一个 PDF：封面 + 每一页，按日期排好。对方在微信、iMessage、WhatsApp 里直接就能翻看，不用装 App。
bookShare.help.en: Turns the whole book into one PDF — a cover, then every page by date. They can flip through it in Messages or WhatsApp, no app needed.

bookShare.empty.zh: 这本书还没有页面，先记一页吧
bookShare.empty.en: This book has no pages yet — add one first

bookShare.saved.zh: 已保存 PDF（{count} 页），可以发给家人
bookShare.saved.en: Saved a PDF ({count} pages) to send to family

bookShare.skipped.zh: （太长了，只放了最近的页，前面 {count} 页没放）
bookShare.skipped.en: (Long book: only the latest pages; {count} earlier ones left out)

bookShare.failed.zh: 没能做成 PDF，请再试一次
bookShare.failed.en: Couldn't make the PDF — please try again

bookShare.thanks.zh: 谢谢，你的选择会帮我们决定先做什么
bookShare.thanks.en: Thanks — this helps us decide what to build next

contribute.title.zh: 想让 TA 也能往这本书里加照片吗？
contribute.title.en: Would you like them to add photos to this book too?

contribute.note.zh: 这个功能还在做，现在只能分享给对方看。你的选择只记在这台设备的测试记录里。
contribute.note.en: This isn't built yet — for now they can look. Your answer is kept only in this device's test log.

contribute.view.zh: 只给 TA 看就够了

contribute.add.zh: 想让 TA 也能加照片

contribute.addHint.zh: 比如另一半、爸妈、爷爷奶奶

suggest.title.en: Books for the people you love

suggest.help.zh: 一个人记，家人随时可以看（分享成 PDF）。
suggest.help.en: You keep it; family can look any time (shared as a PDF).

suggest.parenting.hint.zh: 记录孩子长大，给家人看
suggest.parenting.hint.en: Your child growing up, for the family

suggest.parenting.description.en: Watching you grow, little by little.

shelf.moved.zh: 书架顺序已更新，首页也一样
shelf.moved.en: Shelf order updated — Home follows it too

growth.noNoteYet.zh: 这次还没写感想，点「编辑」写几句。
growth.noNoteYet.en: No reflection yet — tap Edit to add a few words.

samples.note.zh: 手帐里有 {count} 天示例（标着「示例」），用来看看能做出什么样的页面。它们不会被分享，也可以全部移除；你自己写的不受影响。
samples.note.en: Your journal has {count} sample days (marked “Sample”) to show what pages can look like. They're never shared and can be removed; your own pages stay.

samples.confirm.zh: 移除所有示例天？你自己写的内容都会保留。
samples.confirm.en: Remove all sample days? Everything you wrote stays.

read.titleHint.en: Double-click the title to change it

read.editHint.zh: 打开写作页，换照片、文字和装饰
read.editHint.en: Open it to change photos, words and decorations

read.deleteHint.zh: 可以撤销前先确认；照片和录音文件仍保留在本机
read.deleteHint.en: You'll be asked first; media files stay on this device

streak.chip.zh: 连续 {count} 天 · 本周 {week} 天

streak.start.zh: 今天记一页，开始连续记录
streak.start.en: Add a page today to start a streak

streak.first.zh: 今天也记下来了。小日子，一页一页攒起来。
streak.first.en: Today is kept. Little days add up, page by page.

streak.keep.en: One more page. See you tomorrow.

streak.milestone.3.zh: 三天了！一个小习惯正在长出来。
streak.milestone.3.en: Three days! A little habit is starting.

streak.milestone.7.zh: 整整一周！这一周都被好好收藏了。

streak.milestone.14.zh: 两周了，已经是一本小册子的厚度。
streak.milestone.14.en: Two weeks — that's a little booklet.

streak.milestone.30.zh: 一个月！这个月的你，都在书里。
streak.milestone.30.en: A month! All of this month is in your book.

streak.milestone.100.zh: 100 天！值得为自己庆祝一下。

streak.milestone.200.en: 200 days — a big book of life.

streak.milestone.365.zh: 一整年！谢谢你一直记录。
streak.milestone.365.en: A whole year! Thank you for keeping it.

streak.rest.zh: 中间休息了一天，连续没有断。
streak.rest.en: You took a rest day — the streak is still on.

streak.restRule.zh: 每周可以休息一天，连续不会断。
streak.restRule.en: One rest day a week won't break your streak.

streak.continue.zh: 今天记一页，就到第 {count} 天了。
streak.continue.en: Add a page today for day {count}.

streak.begin.zh: 今天记一页，从第 1 天开始。
streak.begin.en: Add a page today to start at day 1.

flip.hint.zh: 左右滑动或点 ‹ › 翻页；电脑上可以用方向键。
flip.hint.en: Swipe or tap ‹ › to turn pages; arrow keys work on a computer.

music.hint.zh: 给这一页配一首轻音乐。看这一天、翻这本书时会轻轻循环播放；导出视频时也会带上。
music.hint.en: Give this page a soft piece of music. It loops quietly when you read the day or flip the book, and goes into the page's video.

music.original.zh: 全部是 Little Days 原创的轻音乐，可以放心用在你的页面、视频和书里。
music.original.en: All original Little Days music — free to use in your pages, videos and books.

music.bookHint.zh: 翻开《{name}》时轻轻循环播放；某一页自己选了音乐时，放那一页的。
music.bookHint.en: Plays softly while “{name}” is open; a page with its own music plays that instead.

story.promptHint.zh: 选几张今天的照片，剩下的交给 Little Days。
story.promptHint.en: Pick a few photos from today — Little Days does the rest.

story.justWriteHint.zh: 不放照片，在纸上写一页
story.justWriteHint.en: No photos: write a page on paper

story.noSetup.zh: 不用先选手帐本、模板或字体 · 之后都能改
story.noSetup.en: No book, template or font to choose first — change anything later

story.groupHint.zh: 按拍摄时间分成了 {count} 个 Moment。点一张照片，可以把它移到前一个 / 后一个 Moment。
story.groupHint.en: Grouped by when they were taken into {count} Moments. Tap a photo to move it to the Moment before or after.

story.toLines.zh: 下一步：每个 Moment 写一句
story.toLines.en: Next: a line for each Moment

story.skipAll.zh: 都可以跳过 · 不需要选模板
story.skipAll.en: Everything can be skipped — no template to pick

story.previewHelp.zh: 每页都可以「换一种」；想自己挪照片、加贴纸就点「自己调整」。保存后会收进书里。
story.previewHelp.en: “Shuffle” any page; “Adjust it myself” to move photos or add stickers. Saving puts it in your book.

story.discard.zh: 不做这个故事了吗？选的照片不会放进手帐。
story.discard.en: Leave this story? The photos won't go into your journal.

story.wordsTitle.zh: 给这几个 Moment 写一句

story.wordsHint.zh: 都可以不写。写了会自动排进页面，看书时也会显示。
story.wordsHint.en: All optional. Words go onto the page and show when you read the book.

story.styleConfirm.zh: 有 {count} 页是你自己调整过的。要一起换成新风格吗？（取消：保留这几页不动，只换其他页）
story.styleConfirm.en: {count} pages were adjusted by you. Restyle them too? (Cancel keeps them as they are and restyles the rest.)

story.relayoutConfirm.zh: 这一页你自己调整过，重新排版会改掉你的调整。继续吗？
story.relayoutConfirm.en: You adjusted this page. Re-layout will undo your changes. Continue?

habits.bookCount.zh: {count} 个习惯 · 本周打卡 {week} 次

habits.bookHint.zh: 成长之书、每周回顾、习惯设置都在这里
habits.bookHint.en: The growth journey, weekly reflections and habit settings

plan.hint.zh: 写下今天要做的，做完打个勾 · 最多 8 件
plan.hint.en: Write what's on today, tick it off · up to 8

plan.carry.zh: 把昨天没做完的 {count} 件搬到今天

habit.deleteHint.zh: 会先问你；它的打卡记录也会一起删除
habit.deleteHint.en: You're asked first; its check-ins go too

habit.editHint.zh: 改名字、类别或每周目标；已经打过的卡不会变。
habit.editHint.en: Change the name, theme or weekly goal; past check-ins stay.

habit.deleteConfirm.zh: 删除「{name}」？它的 {count} 次打卡和心得也会一起删除，不能恢复。
habit.deleteConfirm.en: Delete “{name}”? Its {count} check-ins and notes go too, and can't be brought back.

settings.systemFonts.zh: 黑体、宋体、楷体用的是你设备自带的字体（例如 iPhone 上的苹方、宋体），不随 App 分发，所以不需要另外的许可证；设备没有楷体时，会用 App 自带的霞鹜文楷代替。
settings.systemFonts.en: Sans, Serif and Kai use your device's own fonts (for example PingFang and Songti on iPhone), which are not shipped with the app, so no extra licence is needed; where the device has no Kai font, the bundled LXGW WenKai is used instead.

story.datedFromPhotos.zh: 这些照片是 {date} 拍的，已经记到那一天（预览里可以改日期）
story.datedFromPhotos.en: These photos were taken on {date}, so they go to that day (change the date in the preview)

quick.start.lib.en: Write a line with this photo
